Potato & corn chowder

Original EZEATS recipe · editorially reviewed draft · owner review required · not kitchen-tested.

Tender potato cubes thicken a simple milk-based corn soup.

North American · lunch, dinner, soup · easy

Servings: 4

Prep: 10 min

Cook: 25 min

Total: 35 min (estimate)

Estimated cost: USD 4 per serving. Not a price quote or a CAD conversion.

Diet and allergy suitability: unverified. Ingredient-list screening only, for the exact products specified. Brands, substitutions and cross-contact can change suitability. Editorial review is not kitchen testing or a medical or allergy-safety guarantee.

Known allergens: Milk. This list may be incomplete; check package labels and cross-contact.

Before you cook

  • Before starting, wash hands with soap and water for 20 seconds. Rinse fresh produce under running water and use clean utensils.
  • Check every packaged ingredient label for dietary requirements and allergens, including cross-contact notices. Choose products with no additional allergenic ingredients beyond the warnings listed here; otherwise these ingredient-based recommendations no longer apply. Listed tags apply only to the specified ingredients; they are not allergy-safe guarantees.
  • Refrigerate perishable ingredients until needed. Refrigerate leftovers in shallow containers within 2 hours (within 1 hour above 90°F/32°C); reheat leftovers to 74°C/165°F.

Ingredients

  • 3 medium potatoes (675 g, 1/2-inch cubes)
  • 2 cups frozen corn kernels (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 2 cups pasteurized milk (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 2 cups gluten-free vegan vegetable broth (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1 medium yellow onion (diced)
  • 1 tablespoon butter (Check package labels; use the specified dietary version and check additional allergens and cross-contact notices.)
  • 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme
  • 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper

Cooking instructions

  1. Melt the butter in a pot on medium-low. Cook the yellow onion for 5 minutes.
  2. Add the potatoes, gluten-free vegan vegetable broth and dried thyme. Cover and simmer for 12–15 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
  3. Mash a third of the potatoes against the pot. Stir in the frozen corn kernels, pasteurized milk and ground black pepper.
  4. Heat gently for 5 minutes, stirring and avoiding a hard boil, until steaming throughout. Serve in four bowls.
